market_definition: The Reverse Osmosis Market covers the Brazil market for reverse osmosis (RO) systems, equipment and components used to remove dissolved salts, impurities and contaminants from water through membrane-based filtration. These solutions serve residential, industrial, commercial and municipal requirements for potable water production, process water, high-purity water, wastewater treatment and water reuse. Excludes conventional filtration without RO, standalone ultrafiltration, microfiltration and UV when not part of an RO system, water chemicals unrelated to RO, general water supply and sanitation services, and equipment used only in non-RO treatment.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
